entities.summary: Emmanuel and Samuel Appiah Gyan, known professionally as Twins don't beg, stylised as Twinsdntbeg, are twin photographers in Ghana. The duo began photography in 2015 and have worked with celebrities and figures both locally and internationally. They are the official photographers of the Second Lady of Ghana, Samira Bawumia.
